messages.text: Hello, I hope you're having a nice day. I ordered and paid for a miner months ago; when will it be delivered? Order Shop····.
I can pull it up, I just need one detail that matches the order. What's the email on it?

Thanks, Christian, that matches. Your order is paid, and nothing has shipped yet.

The B. B30 with the Power Kit ships November 7, 2026. Sorry it moved from the original date, that's the current one.

You can follow its progress any time on our shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else I can check for you?

That's the email on the order, thanks. Everything I said stands: the B30 and Power Kit ship November 7, 2026, and your order is paid in full.

Shipping notices go to that address automatically, so worth whitelisting us so the tracking mail doesn't land in spam.

Anything else you'd like me to look at?
Can you give me a tracking link yet?

Not yet, nothing has left the warehouse. The tracking number is created when it ships, and the email goes out the same day to (email hidden)

So: November 7 for the B30 and the Power Kit, tracking lands in your inbox that day.
Before you go, one thing: are you thinking of adding a second, smaller miner alongside the B30, or is the wait making you reconsider the B30 itself?
Thanks for answering, Christian. Enjoy your Sunday, and your B30 ships November 7 with the tracking mail the same day.
